textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component:setColor(0.9, 0.9, 0.9) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.25*game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED)
local text = LOC(game.objectDescription())
local selectedObject = game.SelectedObject()
if (selectedObject and selectedObject:isMonster()) then
local selectedMonsterId = game.selectedMonsterId() local monsterData = game.getMonsterDataFromUniqueId(selectedMonsterId)
if monsterData:isModal() then local modalMonsterData = game.getModalMonsterData(monsterData, 0) local discoveredByText = game.monsterIdDiscoveredBy(modalMonsterData:monsterId()) if (discoveredByText ~= "") then text = text .. "\n\n" .. LOC("DISCOVERED_BY_LABEL") .. " (" .. LOC("MAJOR") .. ")" text = text:gsub("%${PLAYER_NAME}", discoveredByText) end
modalMonsterData = game.getModalMonsterData(monsterData, 1) discoveredByText = game.monsterIdDiscoveredBy(modalMonsterData:monsterId()) if (discoveredByText ~= "") then text = text .. "\n" .. LOC("DISCOVERED_BY_LABEL") .. " (" .. LOC("MINOR") .. ")" text = text:gsub("%${PLAYER_NAME}", discoveredByText) end
else local discoveredByText = game.monsterUidDiscoveredBy(selectedMonsterId) if (discoveredByText ~= "") then text = text .. "\n\n" .. LOC("DISCOVERED_BY_LABEL") .. "\n" text = text:gsub("%${PLAYER_NAME}", discoveredByText) end end end
component("text"):SetString(text) component("layer"):SetString("Clipping")

element.name: InfoLikes

swipeComponent.name: Swiper
swipeComponent.event:
component:V("direction"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuSwipeComponent_SwipeDirectionHorizontal) component:V("mode"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuSwipeComponent_SwipeModeFree) component:V("tSteps"):SetFloat(25.0) component:listenToTouches(element)
local numItems = element.Entries.NumLikes
if numItems > 0 then local itemWidth = element.Entries:E("likeEntry0"):absW()
if(numItems * itemWidth > element:absW()) then component:setScrollSize((numItems*itemWidth)-element:absW()) else component:setScrollSize(0) end end

local first = element.Entries
if(first) then local offset = component:scrollOffset() if(first:getOrientationPosition().x ~= offset and element.Entries:E("likeEntry1") ~= nil) then first:setOrientationPosition(Vector2(offset, first("yOffset"):GetInt())) end end

element.name: Entries
element.event:
-- show the current modal monster's pair -- and dim it depending if it has been activated or not
local currentIslandMode = game.player():getActiveIsland():islandMode() local multiMonster = game.GetMultiMonster(game.selectedMonsterId()) local likedMode = currentIslandMode == 0 and 1 or 0 local likedMonsterData = game.getModalMonsterData(multiMonster:data(), likedMode) local likedModeActivated = multiMonster:isModeActivated(likedMode)
element.NumLikes = 1 element:parent().showMirror = not likedModeActivated
local monsterId = likedMonsterData:monsterId() local entityId = likedMonsterData:entityId()
local templateName = "template_likesentry"
likeEntry = menu:addTemplateElement(templateName, "likeEntry0", element)
likeEntry.EntityId = entityId --likeEntry.MonsterID = monsterId likeEntry:V("MonsterID"):SetInt(monsterId) likeEntry.AnimFile = game.entityAnimFile(entityId) likeEntry.AnimName = game.entityAnimName(entityId)
likeEntry:relativeTo(element) likeEntry:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(0, 4*game.menuScaleX(), -2, lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.VCENTER)) likeEntry:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.HCENTER, lua_sys.VCENTER) likeEntry:setSize(lua_sys.Vector2(105*game.menuScaleX(), 120*game.menuScaleX()))
likeEntry:init() likeEntry:setPositionBroadcast(true) likeEntry:postInit()
--scale by height to fit parent
--need to scale to 1 to get accurate absH likeEntry.Sprite:setScale(lua_sys.Vector2(1.0, 1.0)) local targetSize = 104*game.menuScaleX() local animSize = likeEntry.Sprite:absH() local scaleFactor = targetSize / animSize likeEntry.Sprite:setScale(lua_sys.Vector2(scaleFactor, scaleFactor))
likeEntry.Sprite("layer"):SetString("PopUps")
if not likedModeActivated then likeEntry.Sprite:setColor(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) likeEntry("xOffset"):SetInt(48*game.menuScaleX()) end
--override touch? likeEntry.touch = function() end --or just disable it? likeEntry.Touch("enabled"):SetInt(0) likeEntry.Touch.onTouchDown = function() end likeEntry.Touch.onTouchUp = function() end likeEntry.Touch.onTouchDragged = function() end likeEntry.Touch.onTouchReleased = function() end
--likeEntry:enableDebug(0,1,0,1) --likeEntry.Sprite:enableDebug(0,1,1,1)

aeComponent.name: Sprite
aeComponent.event:
component("animationName"):SetString("xml_bin/fugue_timer_menu_anim.bin")
local currentMode = game.player():getActiveIsland():islandMode() if currentMode == 0 then component("animation"):SetString("fugue_timer_idle_MAJ") else component("animation"):SetString("fugue_timer_idle_MIN") end
component("offsetCenter"):SetInt(1)
local scaleFactor = element:absH() / component:absH() component:setScale(Vector2(scaleFactor, scaleFactor)) component("layer"):SetString("PopUps")

element.event:
element.Touch:V("enabled"):SetInt(1)
local numLikes = element.Entries.NumLikes for i=0,numLikes-1 do element.Entries:E("likeEntry"..i):DoStoredScript("show") end
element.Mirror.Sprite("visible"):SetInt(element.showMirror and 1 or 0)

element.Touch:V("enabled"):SetInt(0)
local numLikes = element.Entries.NumLikes for i=0,numLikes-1 do element.Entries:E("likeEntry"..i):DoStoredScript("hide") end
element.Mirror.Sprite("visible"):SetInt(0)

if(game.selectedObjIsMonster()) then component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("noTranslate"):SetInt(1) else component("multiline"):SetInt(1) end

component("text"):SetString(game.objectName())
component("layer"):SetString("PopUps")
